videos.title: Viajar Mexico
videos.description: Charlie Rubio travels through the city of Bernal and explores Mexico's lesser-known cultural treasures, including the Peña de Bernal monolith and the Querétaro wine region.

videos.title: Travel Diaries Of Rohan And Healer
videos.description: Rohan attempts to get his dog Healer off his fear of water by taking him on a boat ride on the waters of Asia's biggest man-made lake.

videos.title: City Breaks
videos.description: Christina visits the most vibrant modern city of Munich while she explores the history-rich Marienplatz district and Residenz palace.

videos.title: Food Fact Fun
videos.description: Besides witnessing dance performances, Alex enjoys a five-course meal followed by a visit to the Skylon Tower. He then interacts with a wine expert and explores the Niagara Falls by helicopter and ferry.

videos.title: Xplore Philippines
videos.description: Derived from the word 'may nilad', referring to the white flower that once grew abundantly here. Manila, in the Philippines, has modern day skyscrapers but has also managed to retain its rich Spanish influence.

videos.title: Backpack
videos.description: Sabrina Chakici sees sights like Shirvanshah Palace and a fire temple, and hunts for souvenirs at Caravan Serai Bazaar and Carpet Museum, in Baku.

videos.title: Viajar Mexico
videos.description: Charlie Rubio explores one of the many `indigenous paradises' across Mexico, where he receives an opportunity to visit a hidden heron sanctuary on an island.

videos.title: Travel Diaries Of Rohan And Healer
videos.description: Healer and Rohan visit Rishikesh, where they experience the thrill of river rafting on the spirited rapids of the holy river Ganga.

videos.title: City Breaks
videos.description: Christina is in Frankfurt and receives light showers of rain. She decides to beat the rains and head out to one of the smaller towns.

videos.title: Food Fact Fun
videos.description: Alex explores Vancouver starting from Bridges restaurant, Richmond Night Market and Treasure Café. Later he visits Olympic Village and explores Gastown, ending with Capilano Suspension Bridge Park.

videos.title: Xplore Philippines
videos.description: Bohol is a quieter and more calming city of the Philippines. It may not be as developed as Manila and other cities, but nothing can overpower the fragrance of fresh greenery.

videos.title: Backpack
videos.description: After seeing mud volcanoes and rock formations at Gobustan, Sabrina visits attractions like Heydar Aliyev Park and Mausoleum Nizami, in Ganja.

videos.title: Viajar Mexico
videos.description: Charlie visits Monterrey where he heads straight to a spectacular canyon where locals are known to have 'beer and barbecue' picnics. Following this, he explores another picturesque attraction nearby called the Bustamante caves.

videos.title: Travel Diaries Of Rohan And Healer
videos.description: Healer is upset with Rohan as he leaves him behind and goes in search of the big cats of the jungle.

videos.title: City Breaks
videos.description: Christina visits the 2,000-year-old city of Cologne and delves into museums dedicated to showcasing the world's greatest art collections.

videos.title: Food Fact Fun
videos.description: Alex is in Vancouver Island where he tries Saffron salmon, explores Parksville beach, known for its sand sculptures and then explores a 50-year-old Symphony Winery.

videos.title: Xplore Philippines
videos.description: Cebu is the second-largest metropolis in the country and offers a perspective of the Philippines busy life. Boracay is an exquisite beach destination with never before seen pure white sands and blue water.

videos.title: Backpack
videos.description: Sabrina learns about the art form, Shabaka, sees Sheki Summer House and Khinalug Village, gets a crude oil spa treatment and tastes halva, in Sheki, Azerbaijan.

videos.title: Viajar Mexico
videos.description: Charlie Rubio is back to take you on a wild ride across the lesser-explored sides of Mexico.

videos.title: Travel Diaries Of Rohan And Healer
videos.description: Rohan sets out to go paragliding over the picturesque Kumaon mountains of Uttarakhand. Getting Healer, Rohan's furry partner-in-crime, to join him proves to be a rather difficult task.

videos.title: World Heritage
videos.description: From Jama Masjid and Kevda Masjid to Rani Ki Vav and the Mahakali temple atop Pavagadh hill, Champaner-Pavagadh is a hub of historical treasures. Exploring these historical structures vividly recalls their era of prosperity.

videos.title: Bliss
videos.description: Along with basking in the idyllic beach scenes of Bulgaria, Kirsty admires the art in Helena resort, and experiences local traditions and cuisine. Adventure seekers can opt for activities like water-skiing, parasailing, wing-surfing, and jet skiing.

videos.title: Best From the Rest
videos.description: Keeping kids entertained is not a Herculean task in Thailand, so they live their childhood fantasies as one unrolls a freewheeling adventure in The Land of Smiles.

videos.title: World Heritage
videos.description: Khajuraho temples are a vivid illustration of the principle, showcasing an eternal bond between earthly bliss and spiritual satisfaction.
